items.title: Make validation timeout failures diagnose timeout configuration clearly
items.context: runValidationCommand currently marks timedOut and executeValidationPlan renders only "(timed out)". Add explicit guidance that the command was killed by timeout and that validate.commands[].timeoutMs may need adjustment; do not hide real test failures.

items.title: Make stale verification evidence recovery explain hash-binding drift
items.context: renderEvidenceStaleHint already appears in session_brief/story_advance/validate hints, but it uses legacy koala command wording and does not state that stale means HEAD/material hash binding changed rather than proof that test logic failed.

items.title: Improve owner lease recovery guidance for same-worktree context switches
items.context: Owner lease gate and session_brief already enforce active/stale ownership. Add same-worktree detection/guidance so context compaction in the same story worktree gets safer instructions before using forceTakeover; preserve fail-closed behavior.

items.title: Clarify delivery-check fallback without forging reviewer authority
items.context: DONE gate correctly requires signed delivery-check.json. When delivery reviewer tooling is unavailable, hints should state the compliant fallback boundary: delivery_check_set must still be executed as the delivery reviewer actor/provenance, not by the main agent pretending to review itself.

items.title: Add unsupported codex core-command namespace suggestions
items.context: The CLI supports lattice codex verify/doctor but lattice codex session_brief and lattice codex aux_doc_list fail with unhelpful suggestions. Add unknown-command guidance or aliases to route core commands to ordinary lattice equivalents without changing gate semantics.
